import { DisplayObject, DisplayObjectContainer, Event, Shape, trace } from '../shim';
import { EventWatcher } from './EventWatcher';
import { LeftButton } from './LeftButton';
import { RightButton } from './RightButton';

export class MainTimeline extends EventWatcher {
  public declare l_button: LeftButton;
  public declare r_button: RightButton;
  invocation: any = 0;
  destroy_me: any = false;

  public constructor() {
    super();
    this.enter_frame_controller = this.enter_frame_controller.bind(this);
    this.exit_frame_controller = this.exit_frame_controller.bind(this);
    this.frame1 = this.frame1.bind(this);
    this.frame2 = this.frame2.bind(this);
    this.frame3 = this.frame3.bind(this);
    this.addFrameScript(0,this.frame1,1,this.frame2,2,this.frame3);
    this.addEventListener(Event.ENTER_FRAME,this.enter_frame_controller);
    this.addEventListener(Event.EXIT_FRAME,this.exit_frame_controller);
  }

  inspect(from: DisplayObject): void {
    var child: any = undefined;
    var num_children: any = undefined;
    var i: any = undefined;
    if (from instanceof DisplayObjectContainer) {
      num_children = 0;
      for (i = 0; i < from.numChildren; i += 1) {
        if (from.getChildAt(i)) {
          num_children += 1;
        }
      }
      trace("/// (Container:",from.name,"with",num_children,"children)");
      for (i = 0; i < from.numChildren; i += 1) {
        child = from.getChildAt(i);
        if (child) {
          this.inspect(child);
        }
      }
    } else if (!(from instanceof Shape)) {
      trace("/// (Unknown:",from.name,")");
    }
  }

  enter_frame_controller(evt: Event): void {
    ++this.invocation;
    if (this.invocation == 30) {
      this.destroy_me = true;
    }
    this.inspect(this);
  }

  exit_frame_controller(evt: Event): void {
    this.inspect(this);
    if (this.destroy_me) {
      this.destroy();
      this.l_button.destroy();
      this.r_button.destroy();
      this.removeEventListener(Event.ENTER_FRAME,this.enter_frame_controller);
      this.removeEventListener(Event.EXIT_FRAME,this.exit_frame_controller);
      this.stop();
    }
  }

  frame1(): void {
    trace("//MainTimeline frame 1");
  }

  frame2(): void {
    trace("//MainTimeline frame 2");
  }

  frame3(): void {
    trace("//MainTimeline frame 3");
  }
}
